name: Deploy
description: Trigger the ability upon placing the card on the board.

name: Banish
description: Removes a card from the game. Does not trigger Last Word.

name: Devour
description: Target an allied unit, destroy it, then boost self by it’s power.

name: Hoard $X$
description: Trigger the ability if you have X or more sellary.

name: Destroy
description: Reduce health to 0.

name: Last Word
description: Trigger the ability upon the destruction of the card.

name: Tribute $X$
description: Upon playing a card, you may pay X sellary to trigger the ability.

name: Upkeep $X$
description: Deduct X sellary. If this condition is not met, the ability is not triggered.

name: Income $X$
description: Profit X at the start of your turn.

name: Profit $X$
description: Gain X sellary.

name: Timer $X$
description: At the end of your turn, reduce timer by 1. Once the timer reaches 0, trigger the ability.

Counter** $X$
A numerical value. ^count

**Control
description: To control a card means to have it placed on your side of the board.

name: Crit
description: Deal double damage instead.

name: Spy
description: Place the card on opponent’s board.

name: Pay $X$
description: Spend X sellary to trigger the abiliity.

name: Order $X$
description: Use X charges to triger an ability. If there’s no X, use 1 charge.

name: Boost $X$
description: Increase unit’s power by X.

name: Heal $X$
description: Increase unit’s power by X, but can’t go over base health. If there’s no X, boost fully until base health.

name: Spot Valid 67
description: If you see the number 6 adjacent to number 7, trigger the ability.

name: Deathblow
description: Trigger the ability upon destroying a unit.

name: Cleanse
description: Remove all status effects.

name: Discard
description: Move to graveyard.

name: Permanent {status}
description: The status does not diminish, and cannot be cleansed by any means.

name: Block $X$
description: Reduce incoming damage by X. Statuses bypass this.

name: Seize $X$
description: Deduct X sellary from {specified}, then profit X.

name: Area
description: includes area, adjacent up-down, left-right, and diagonals.
